name: 55121 · Eagan, MN
findings: ZIP 55121 (Eagan) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55121 (Eagan) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
